items.title: Pandas
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Ever dreamt about becoming a panda? That's a bit weird, but now you can anyway! Put on one of 9 unique skins; including a chef, royal and VIP skin!

+ 7 wild panda outfits
+ 2 classic panda skins

items.title: Crazy Donuts
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Who doesn't love donuts? With a chocolate donut, lemon glazed, and even an explosive creeper donut, there's something for everyone here!

+ 10 funny donut skins
+ A variety of toppings!

items.title: Friends Base
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Start a new adventure with your friends. Choose which secret base suits you, compete to see which of you can survive better, role-play with friends or just have fun and play in your own style.

+ Two different bases on the same map
+ Perfect for role-playing games and hide-and-seek
+ Support for multiplayer with friends
+ By In Mine

items.title: Colors of The Rainbow
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Turn Minecraft into a rainbow with these great skins.
One free skin!

items.title: Neon Squad
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Enrich your life with the fanciest colors in town! Try new styles worn by stylish teens who are ready to try on the most courageous outfits. Everyone needs some colors in their lives! So don't miss this chance and taste the rainbow!

+ 1 free skin
+ 11 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Anime Summer Fashion
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Show off your anime summer style and create your own fashion trends! Vibe with friends, build your own world, and create your own story. Choose your favourite of twelve skins and get ready for a sizzling summer! One free skin included.
From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Find Da Button 4
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for another epic find the button mystery map with multiple levels? Free your mind from your all your crafting troubles as you try to solve these ancient puzzles with or without friends!
* Lots of rooms to escape! 
* Multiplayer friendly!
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Find Da Button 3
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Prepare for this find the button game mode? If you like mystery and escape rooms you will love this epic mind bending and frustrating mini game! Time to find the hidden objective and free yourself from these mysterious puzzles! 
* Multiplayer friendly!
* 15 crazy cool levels!
* You must be focused and carefree to see the secrets that lay wait! 
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Mob Agents 2
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
The mob agents are back! Grab one of these 8 skins and face the crime!

+8 mobs in suits
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Space Wars
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Among these astronauts and aliens is an inevitable war! Which side are you on in this galactic battle?

- 14 skins

items.title: Sky Dragon Skins
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Up high in the sky there are ferocious flying beast that breathe fire! Become a sky dragon with one of these awesome HD skins. Which of these trending dragon skins will choose for your skyblock adventures?

- 11 skins

items.title: The Best Skyblock Ever
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Welcome to The Best Skyblock Ever. You are in a classic Skyblock except that resources are scarce. To help you, sheep and cows will be your best friends, and there are Lucky Blocks about.

- Over 30 new entities
- Luckyblocks
- Shop
- Floating islands with various biomes
- Museum
- Structures (village, temple, manor, dungeon...)
- 5 skins

items.title: Minimalism Mobs
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: Mobblocks minimalism pack just expanded into mobs.

items.title: Sausages!
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Dress up as the coolest sausage around! You can become a millionaire sausage, a deep sea diver or even an 80s aerobics instructor!

+ 7 derpy skins
+ Super random outfits

items.title: TNTeens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Who says adults should be in charge of demolition? Blow up your world in style with these explosive skins! Use this pack while you're roleplaying with friends, blowing up your city, or just being that one person who won't stop making explosions!

- 10 TNT themed teen skins
- Great for roleplay
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Lothiredon.

items.title: Neon Fashion
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Colors everywhere! There are plenty of bright and stylish options for you to choose from. Show off your exciting fashion sense with these modern designs!

- 8 skins for roleplay
- Colorful and unique for teens
- Licensed by Xenon Design and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: The Zombie
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
One of the first monsters you meet in your adventure! Play as a zombie and discover its life!

- 15 zombie skins
- Ideal for roleplay
- By Pixelusion & SucreGappySan

items.title: SKY WARS Pros
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: SKY WARS Pros are ready for any PvP battle! Time to lead the charge into your next sky wars match with these epic outfits!

items.title: Super Fortress
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Here's the SUPER FORTRESS, the only modern complex with advanced military defenses! Build your base in safety with its massive anti-mob GUNS. Utilize the LASER WALL and WARSHIP to defend against its enemies! See how far you can go in survival with this MODERN BASE.

+ Contains a MASSIVE MODERN SUPER FORTRESS
+ Survival farm
+ LASER defenses
+ Modern WARSHIP
+ Lighthouse

items.title: Chill Luxury
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Relax with Chill Luxury, the only skin pack with realistic luxury outfits! Dress in designer clothes, flex with friends and chill in your millionaire mansion. Use these luxurious skins to become the coolest teen in the city or jump in your private jet to go play skyblock. Try out all the skins to find out which one fits you best!

+ 12 popular realistic skins
+ 1 free skin

items.title: High School Teens
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Pick from up to 13 different styles and match with your best friends! Roll up to lunch together or role-play at Mineville High

items.title: Among Agents
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Choose your favorite agent to get the mission done. Go undercover with these unique HD skins!

+ Perfect for role-play

items.title: Mob Blocks
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Sneak around Minecraft with these block camo skins! Troll your friends by disguising yourself as a block in Minecraft! From the infinite world, all the way to the end.

items.title: Among The Galaxy
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Travel Worlds, Realms, and Servers in your new spacesuits! There are so many to choose from!
